news.title: POWERGRID reports 14,600 MVA commissioned in Q2 FY27
news.summary: The September 2026 quarter added 14,600 MVA of transformation capacity, including commissioning of the 765 kV Koppal-II and Bidar substations. That is utility grid capacity, not a transformer order value.

news.title: Voltamp starts commercial production at Jarod Unit III
news.summary: Voltamp reports commercial production starting 7 October 2026 at its new power-transformer facility near Jarod, Vadodara.

news.title: Hitachi Energy announces a new large power transformer plant in Karjan
news.summary: Hitachi Energy India announced approximately ₹2,000 crore for a new Karjan, Vadodara factory. The announcement is not proof of live capacity.
news.publisher: Hitachi Energy India release filed with NSE

market_context.summary: IEEMA reports power transformers up 31.6% and distribution transformers up 3.4% in its industry growth index. These are index movements, not a market-size or factory-capacity estimate.
